purpose: Final hardening before real process UI testing: verify MAF 1.6 adoption, close read-model/finalizer parity gaps, and prepare step0 live smoke gate.
keyFindings: MAF 1.6 package upgrade is real and reflection proof exists.
Several MAF 1.6 features are intentionally deferred or implemented through CanDoItAll/Microsoft.Extensions.AI fallbacks rather than direct 1.6 APIs.
RecordArtifactAsync dedupe scope is now corrected to reject same-run projection/external-reference collisions across different step/expectation scopes.
Read-model parity is incomplete: current read model explicitly downgrades ContentUnavailable diagnostics, but not all finalizer validation statuses.
Before full live tests, run a controlled step0 live smoke and abort unless artifact validation, read model, diagnostics, tool receipts, and recovery state all agree.
